candidate_options.option: Consider five-year aromatase inhibitor without routine chemotherapy.

patient_facts.text: Postmenopausal with pT1c pN0 ER/PR-positive, HER2-negative disease and recurrence score 22.

guideline_facts.text: Postmenopausal node-negative disease with score 0–25 supports endocrine therapy without routine chemotherapy.
A five-year aromatase inhibitor is preferred initially after menopause, with extension reviewed at year five.

candidate_options.model_inference: Recorded menopause and score fit this discussion option [Patient record; Genomic assay 2026-09-28; Guidelines v2025.2].
cautions: Review bone and cardiovascular risks [Problem list; Radiology 2026-09-21; Safety checklist v2025.1].

candidate_options.option: Consider tamoxifen if an aromatase inhibitor is not tolerated.

patient_facts.text: Prior DVT was treated in 2019; provocation is unknown.

guideline_facts.text: Tamoxifen is an alternative for aromatase-inhibitor intolerance, but prior DVT is a relative contraindication requiring specialist review.
Prior DVT warrants hematology involvement and a documented risk discussion.
sources: Oncology Care Guidelines safety checklist v2025.1

candidate_options.model_inference: Thrombosis makes this a complicated fallback, not an absolute prohibition [Problem list; Guidelines v2025.2].
cautions: Review uterine symptoms/history and drug interactions [Safety checklist v2025.1].

candidate_options.option: Pair aromatase-inhibitor consideration with bone-risk management.

patient_facts.text: Lumbar T-score −2.1 from November 2024; calcium/vitamin D active.

guideline_facts.text: Repeat baseline DEXA if over 24 months old; T-score −2.0 to −2.5 on an aromatase inhibitor warrants calcium/vitamin D and DEXA every 1–2 years.
Consider bisphosphonate or denosumab for T-score ≤−2.5 or high fracture risk.

candidate_options.model_inference: Monitoring is supported; medication depends on fracture risk, and this DEXA is not yet over 24 months old at the October 2026 visit [Problem list; Clinic note 2026-10-05; Guidelines v2025.2].
cautions: Do not infer an automatic antiresorptive indication from this T-score alone [Guidelines v2025.2].

patient_facts.text: Lumpectomy achieved negative margins for a 1.9 cm node-negative ER-positive tumor.

guideline_facts.text: Whole-breast radiation is recommended after lumpectomy; omission may be considered in selected low-risk ER-positive patients age 70 or older.

cautions: Confirm age before omission review; citation-only partial-breast evidence was not used [Evidence specialist].
